item.title: Koitore ~Ren-ai Training~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gindokei
  • 発売日: 2007-06-29
  • スコア: 6.92/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: こいとれ ～REN-AI TRAINING～
  • 英語名: Koitore Ren-ai Training

あらすじ

The main character is Yuu, who has just entered a high school. One day, he is forcibly taken to the club room of the love and romance club, and he finally joins them. What they do is to enjoy love and romance based on certain rules. The main purpose of this club is to help the members be able to enjoy communications with other people.

item.title: Otaku ☆ Masshigura
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gindokei
  • 発売日: 2006-09-29
  • スコア: 7.0200000000000005/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おたく☆まっしぐら
  • 英語名: Otaku ☆ Masshigura

别名

  • Otagura

あらすじ

This is a geek’s dream come true! Having just graduated from high school, our protagonist goes to live in Tokyo, where he frequently embraces his otaku-dom by visiting Akihabara. During his visits, he meets a wide assortment of women–each with their own inklings of otaku-ness. From garage kits, to role play, to UFOs, to video games; and each one is into cosplay and is too hot for her own nerdiness. What self-respecting otaku could resist!?

item.title: Gakuto!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gindokei
  • 発売日: 2006-03-17
  • スコア: 6.409999999999999/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: がくと！
  • 英語名: Gakuto!

あらすじ

Misuzaku School hosts over 100,000 students. As discipline committee goes on rampage, main character suggests a new set of rules, but to enforce them he needs to win school elections. There are a lot of candidates to compete with - like a hentai girl who wants to change school uniform into swimsuits or a martial artist girl who wants to turn school into fighting grounds. But the root of evil is discipline committee chairman who is trying to turn the school into his own harem. To win the elections protagonist must get the buttons that all candidates have. A new school life of love, battle and conspiracy begins!
